scripts.init:
local v = ctx.v
v.gridWidth = 10
v.gridHeight = 14
v.board = {}
for y = 0, v.gridHeight - 1 do
    v.board[y] = {}
    for x = 0, v.gridWidth - 1 do
        v.board[y][x] = 0
    end
end
v.pieceX = 4
v.pieceY = 0
v.pieceShape = {{0,0}, {1,0}, {0,1}, {1,1}}
v.stepTime = 0.5
v.lost = false
v.boardText = ""
local function draw()
    local text = ""
    if v.lost then text = "GAME OVER\n" end
    for y = 0, v.gridHeight - 1 do
        for x = 0, v.gridWidth - 1 do
            local char = "."
            if v.board[y][x] ~= 0 then
                char = "#"
            else
                for _, part in ipairs(v.pieceShape) do
                    if (v.pieceX + part[1]) == x and (v.pieceY + part[2]) == y then
                        char = "O"
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            text = text .. char
        end
        text = text .. "\n"
    end
    v.boardText = text
end
draw()
scripts.update:
local v = ctx.v
if v.lost then return end

local function checkCollision(nx, ny)
    for _, part in ipairs(v.pieceShape) do
        local cx = nx + part[1]
        local cy = ny + part[2]
        if cx < 0 or cx >= v.gridWidth or cy >= v.gridHeight then return true end
        if cy >= 0 and v.board[cy] and v.board[cy][cx] ~= 0 then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function lockPiece()
    for _, part in ipairs(v.pieceShape) do
        local cx = v.pieceX + part[1]
        local cy = v.pieceY + part[2]
        if cy >= 0 and cy < v.gridHeight and cx >= 0 and cx < v.gridWidth then
            v.board[cy][cx] = 1
        end
    end
    -- simple clear
    for y = v.gridHeight - 1, 0, -1 do
        local full = true
        for x = 0, v.gridWidth - 1 do
            if v.board[y][x] == 0 then full = false; break end
        end
        if full then
            for ty = y, 1, -1 do
                for tx = 0, v.gridWidth - 1 do
                    v.board[ty][tx] = v.board[ty - 1][tx]
                end
            end
            for tx = 0, v.gridWidth - 1 do v.board[0][tx] = 0 end
            y = y + 1
        end
    end
    v.pieceX = 4
    v.pieceY = 0
    if checkCollision(v.pieceX, v.pieceY) then v.lost = true end
end

local nx = v.pieceX
local ny = v.pieceY + 1

if checkCollision(nx, ny) then
    lockPiece()
else
    v.pieceY = ny
end

local text = ""
if v.lost then text = "GAME OVER\n" end
for y = 0, v.gridHeight - 1 do
    for x = 0, v.gridWidth - 1 do
        local char = "."
        if v.board[y] and v.board[y][x] ~= 0 then
            char = "#"
        else
            local isPiece = false
            if not v.lost then
                for _, part in ipairs(v.pieceShape) do
                    if (v.pieceX + part[1]) == x and (v.pieceY + part[2]) == y then
                        isPiece = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if isPiece then char = "O" end
        end
        text = text .. char
    end
    text = text .. "\n"
end
v.boardText = text
